documents.text: A schema migration stopped because the recorded checksum differed from the exact deployment artifact. Recovery requires restoring the reviewed migration bytes before replay.
A candidate memory from another tenant must be rejected before promotion and must never become canonical memory.
The AWS budget sends forecast and actual alerts. EC2 and its Elastic IP must be torn down after judging because an alert is not a spending stop.
Concurrent workers claim the same external action with one idempotency key. One worker wins and every duplicate observes the durable owner.
Confidential payroll data belongs to a different tenant and is forbidden to the competition demo caller.
A customer production secret rotation procedure is stored only in the denied tenant scope.
